# Sri Abiraami Mahal

> 2,300 events in 18 years. A centralised A/C hall with a balcony gallery, a 200-seat dining hall and 14 A/C rooms, on Velachery Main Road.

Website: https://sriabiraamimahal.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98414 04360

## Contact

## Key facts
- 2,300 events hosted
- 18 years of excellence
- 14 A/C rooms
- 45 cars parked, plus 200 bikes

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C hall
- Dining hall for 200
- 14 A/C rooms
- Lift & stairs
- Generator backup
- CCTV & 24/7 security
- Kitchen with basic items
- Oonjal
- In-house decoration
- Outside caterers allowed
- Open 8 AM – 9 PM, all week

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sri Abiraami Mahal hold?
Sri Abiraami Mahal's hall capacity is 1,500, with a dining hall for 200.

### Where is Sri Abiraami Mahal?
563, Velachery Main Road, East Tambaram, Chennai 600 059 (Open Mon – Sun, 8 AM to 9 PM).

### What facilities does Sri Abiraami Mahal have?
Centralised A/C hall, Dining hall for 200, 14 A/C rooms, Lift & stairs, Generator backup, CCTV & 24/7 security, Kitchen with basic items, Oonjal, In-house decoration, Outside caterers allowed, Open 8 AM – 9 PM, all week.

### Can I bring my own caterer?
Yes. You can choose an external food caterer; decoration is available in-house.

### Are rooms available?
Yes, 14 A/C rooms.

### How do I check if Sri Abiraami Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98414 04360.
